pages.text: One sunny afternoon, <name> and his friends decided to bake cookies. Flour puffed in the air, chocolate chips danced into the bowl, and the oven smelled warm and sweet.
When the cookies were done, everyone’s eyes grew wide. “I want the biggest cookie!” said one friend. “Me too!” said another.
<name> frowned. How could everyone be happy? Just then, a talking chocolate chip tumbled onto the counter. “Why not share fairly?” it said.
A plucky toy robot beeped, “Divide each cookie into equal pieces. That way, everyone gets the same size!”
<name> counted carefully, breaking the cookies into little squares. Each friend clapped when they got the same-sized pieces. Even the chocolate chips cheered, bouncing happily on top.

“Sharing makes everyone happy,” <name> said, nibbling his cookie. All the friends laughed and munched together, enjoying their sweet treats and the fun of baking as a team. <name> realized that fairness and sharing made the cookies taste even better.
